transcript.text: Bosch SMS25AW00G, came back to E:09 on the display and the dishes are washed but stone cold. Is this an expensive fix?

E:09 on your Bosch means: Flow-through heating element / heating circuit failure. From what you have described, the most likely cause is circulation-pump-with-heater assembly (flow-through). To check the heating, run an intensive or 65°C programme with a normal load. At the end, are the dishes hot and steamy, or still cold?
Both the hot programme and eco have come out cold on the last few runs, dishes are definitely cold at the end. Is that enough to go on, or is there something else to check?
Does the cycle run much longer than normal, as if waiting to heat?
Yes, the cycle has been very long or it stops altogether on the last three runs. The washing sound itself is normal though.
Is the whole wash cold (not just wet dishes), and do you know the make/model so we can tell if it has a separate element or a flow-through heater?
Yes, the whole wash is cold, not just the dishes. The model is a Bosch SMS25AW00G, as I said in my first message.
From what you have checked, this needs an appliance engineer to look at it: the next steps are beyond the checks that are safe to do yourself.
